maddeler.e:
تبحبحت (form IIq)
# تَبَحْبَحْتُ (tabaḥbaḥtu) /ta.baħ.baħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تَبَحْبَحْتَ (tabaḥbaḥta) /ta.baħ.baħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تَبَحْبَحْتِ (tabaḥbaḥti) /ta.baħ.baħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تَبَحْبَحَتْ (tabaḥbaḥat) /ta.baħ.ba.ħat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
